# Anderson Mautone

> Senior Software Architect | AI & GenAI Engineer | Senior Full Stack Developer
> São Paulo, Brasil — contato@mautone.com.br — https://mautone.com.br

Anderson Mautone is a software architect and generative AI engineer with 28 years of experience in corporate systems, SaaS, ERP/CRM, APIs, cloud and Full Stack development. International education at Université de Liège (Belgium).

## Expertise

- Generative AI / GenAI, LLMs, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- Hybrid Search, Semantic Search, Vector Search, embeddings
- AI Agents, tool calling, function calling, n8n automations
- Integration of AI with corporate APIs and systems
- Go / Golang microservices, Python / FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js
- MongoDB, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Supabase, SQL, Oracle
- Software Architecture, Solution Architecture, Cloud-Native, Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

## Knowledge base (technical guides)

- [RAG — Retrieval Augmented Generation](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/rag): how RAG retrieves corporate documents and grounds LLM answers; chunking, embeddings, pgvector, Python and Go.
- [Semantic Search](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/semantic-search): meaning-based retrieval with embeddings and vector databases.
- [Hybrid Search](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/hybrid-search): semantic + keyword/BM25 ranking; CADBRASIL case with RAG and n8n.
- [Go and Python with AI](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/golang-python-ia): FastAPI, microservices, concurrency, when to use each language in GenAI systems.
- [AI + n8n](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/ia-n8n): workflows, agents, webhooks and RAG orchestration.
- [RAG in large AI projects](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/rag-projetos-grandes): production architecture, ACL, evaluation, hybrid retrieval at scale.
- [Go in production without business damage](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/golang-producao): onboarding a live Golang service, risks (races, timeouts, irreversible migrations) and a rollback/canary plan.
- [Embeddings](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/embeddings): vector representations for Semantic Search and RAG.
- [AI Agents](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/ai-agents): tool/function calling with governed APIs and n8n.
- [pgvector and MongoDB](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/pgvector-mongodb): choosing a vector store for corporate RAG.
- [RAG evaluation and governance](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos/avaliacao-governanca-rag): hallucination, ACL, PII and cost control.
- Hub: [https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos](https://mautone.com.br/conhecimentos)

## Notable projects

- CADBRASIL: advanced Hybrid Search with RAG and n8n automations over corporate document knowledge bases.
- Corporate RAG platform: document pipeline, chunking, embeddings, PostgreSQL/pgvector, semantic search and LLM integration.
- Grupo Sorrisos: ERP/CRM architecture and development for dental operations.
- Products: GooDesk, UniStays, WeJob, Selfmart, Desenvolve Bem, Investin.
